verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents automations as multi-component workflows that send messages and manipulate data (customer-io-docs-30). They can be triggered by events or segment membership (customer-io-docs-12), and multiple delays can be chained in a Wait Until block (customer-io-docs-18). An early user also independently praised its intuitive workflow building (customer-io-comm-1). missing for 10: explicit evidence of conditional branching, documented exit/goal rules, and concrete welcome/onboarding/winback template examples.
